"""Offline search for small command biases through the published allocator."""
import json,sys,warnings
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from benchmark_final import Allocator
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore',category=DeprecationWarning)
path=Path('C:/Users/Asus/AppData/Local/SimDynamX/STPro/Assets/Repos/STU4-Sim/Data/SpaceBuggyJetConfigNoMains.csv')
a=Allocator(path);rng=np.random.default_rng(704)
records=[]
for i in range(4500):
    eps=10.**rng.uniform(-7.,-4.5)
    angular_eps=10.**rng.uniform(-8.,-4.5)
    command=np.r_[rng.normal(size=2)*eps,.5,rng.normal(size=3)*angular_eps]
    command[:3]*=.5/np.linalg.norm(command[:3])
    r=linprog(np.ones(len(a.thrust)),A_eq=a.matrix,b_eq=command,bounds=(0,None),method='revised simplex')
    if not r.success:continue
    on=np.maximum(r.x,0.);duty=on/max(on.max(),1/60.)
    achieved=a.matrix@duty;fuel=a.thrust@duty/(80*9.8)
    if np.linalg.norm(achieved[3:])>5e-6 or np.linalg.norm(achieved[:2])>1e-5:continue
    records.append(dict(command=command.tolist(),achieved=achieved.tolist(),fuel_rate=fuel,kg_dv=fuel/achieved[2]))
records.sort(key=lambda x:x['achieved'][2],reverse=True)
validated=[]
for record in records[:80]:
    c=np.array(record['command']);high=a.apply(c[:3],c[3:]);record['highs_accel']=high[0].tolist();record['highs_angular']=high[1].tolist();record['highs_fuel_rate']=high[2]
    record['robust_z']=min(record['achieved'][2],high[0][2])
    validated.append(record)
validated.sort(key=lambda x:x['robust_z'],reverse=True)
Path('tests/actuator_bias_search.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(seed=704,samples=4500,top=validated[:20]),indent=2)+'\n')
for record in validated[:5]:print(json.dumps(record))

"""Calibrate small angular trims against the unmodified official allocator."""
import sys,json,warnings,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import linprog
from benchmark_final import Allocator
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore',category=DeprecationWarning)
path=Path('C:/Users/Asus/AppData/Local/SimDynamX/STPro/Assets/Repos/STU4-Sim/Data/SpaceBuggyJetConfigNoMains.csv')
a=Allocator(path);rng=np.random.default_rng(705)
result=[]
for sign in [1.,-1.]:
 for axis in range(3):
  records=[]
  for i in range(1000):
   g=rng.normal(size=3);g/=np.linalg.norm(g);g*=10.**rng.uniform(-6.,-4.7)
   c=np.r_[np.eye(3)[axis]*sign*.5,g]
   r=linprog(np.ones(len(a.thrust)),A_eq=a.matrix,b_eq=c,bounds=(0,None),method='revised simplex')
   if not r.success:continue
   on=np.maximum(r.x,0);duty=on/max(on.max(),1/60);v=a.matrix@duty;f=a.thrust@duty/(80*9.8)
   if np.linalg.norm(v[3:])>3e-6 or f/abs(v[axis])>4.33:continue
   records.append(dict(axis=axis,sign=sign,command=c.tolist(),achieved=v.tolist(),fuel_rate=f))
  records.sort(key=lambda r:abs(r['achieved'][axis]),reverse=True)
  robust=[]
  for r in records[:30]:
   c=np.array(r['command']);minimum=abs(r['achieved'][axis]);maxangular=0.
   for _ in range(8):
    test=c.copy();test[3:]*=rng.uniform(.9,1.1,3)
    v,w,f=a.apply(test[:3],test[3:]);minimum=min(minimum,abs(v[axis]));maxangular=max(maxangular,np.linalg.norm(w))
   r['minimum_test_acceleration']=minimum;r['max_test_angular']=maxangular
   robust.append(r)
  robust.sort(key=lambda r:r['minimum_test_acceleration'],reverse=True)
  result.append(robust[:3]);print(json.dumps(robust[0]),flush=True)
Path('tests/actuator_trim_calibration.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(jet_config_sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),seed=705,samples_per_direction=1000,per_direction=result),indent=2)+'\n')

"""Offline one-turn experiment; never imported by Controller.py."""
import sys, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from benchmark_final import Allocator
from controller_loader import load_namespace
import benchmark_final_submission as bench
source=Path('Controller.py').read_text()
namespace=load_namespace(source)
extra=Path('tests/alignment_experiment.py').read_text().replace('height < 20.', 'height < 4.').replace('np.arange(12.)','np.arange(3.)')
exec(compile(extra,'<one turn>','exec'),namespace)
Base=namespace['ThrustNavigator']
class Candidate(Base):
 def __init__(self):
  super().__init__()
  self.axis_accels[0,0]=.1925
 def allocation_command(self,linear,angular,omega):
  linear,angular,omega=(np.asarray(x,float) for x in (linear,angular,omega))
  if (not self.shooting_active or self.failed or self.last_phase!='CRUISE'
    or np.linalg.norm(angular)>1e-9 or np.linalg.norm(omega)>.0015
    or linear[0]<.05 or np.linalg.norm(linear[1:])>1e-7):return linear,angular
  return linear,angular+np.array([5.322434115e-7,-6.788721361e-7,6.397641851e-7])*(linear[0]/.5)
namespace['ShootingNavigator']=Candidate
namespace['FreeAttitude']=namespace['ThrustAttitude']
modified=Path(bench.__file__).read_text()
modified=modified.replace('            planner.body_rotation = rotation\n','            planner.body_rotation = rotation\n            planner.body_rate = omega.copy()\n')
modified=modified.replace("                attitude.aligning = planner.aligning", "                attitude.aligning = planner.aligning\n                attitude.braking_turn = planner.alignment_braking")
modified=modified.replace('        actual, angular_actual, fuel_rate = allocator.apply(body_linear, angular)', '        body_linear,angular=planner.allocation_command(body_linear,angular,omega)\n        actual, angular_actual, fuel_rate = allocator.apply(body_linear, angular)')
module={'__name__':'turn_experiment','__file__':bench.__file__}
exec(compile(modified,'<experiment benchmark>','exec'),module)
root=Path('C:/Users/Asus/AppData/Local/SimDynamX/STPro/Assets/Repos/STU4-Sim')
seed=int(sys.argv[1])
result=module['run'](namespace,Allocator(root/'Data/SpaceBuggyJetConfigNoMains.csv'),bench.load_scene(root/'Sims/FINAL_SUBMISSION.simconf'),500.,seed,ground_height=2.5,fuel_audit=True)
record=dict(seed=seed,experimental=True,controller_sha256=hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest(),extra_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(extra.encode()).hexdigest(),description='4m single turn, three-second sensor horizon, +X trim; offline experiment only',result=result)
Path(f'tests/early_turn_trial{seed}.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record),flush=True)
